role: The food base class: heal amount, saturation modifier, wolf-favourite meat, the always-edible flag and the eat-time potion fields; onEaten feeds FoodStats, plays the burp and runs onFoodEaten.

members.name: healAmount, saturationModifier, isWolfsFavoriteMeat, alwaysEdible, potionId, potionDuration, potionAmplifier, potionEffectProbability
members.note: heal, saturation, wolfs_meat and always_edible are ITEMS fields; the potion fields are hardcoded per item id in survival.c's sr_pot_food_effect instead of per-instance fields

members.name: ItemFood(int, float, boolean)
members.note: every food row carries heal, saturation and wolfs_meat

members.name: onEaten
members.note: the stack decrement, food_add_stats into FoodStats and the burp

members.name: onFoodEaten
members.note: potion.c:potion_apply_food (called by survival.c:sr_pot_food_effect with World.rand): the golden apples, the pufferfish, and the ItemFood potion fields per item (rotten flesh hunger 30 0.8, spider eye poison 5 1.0, raw chicken hunger 30 0.3, poisonous potato poison 5 0.6) with the probability draw; per-instance fields are not carried. food-potato-s1, food-chicken-s1

members.name: onItemRightClick
members.note: the canEat(alwaysEdible) gate and setItemInUse; the hunger gate runs in surv_server_food_tick

members.name: isWolfsFavoriteMeat
members.note: n/a: both callers are EntityWolf's (wolves = off)

members.name: setPotionEffect(int,I,I,F)
members.note: the per-item calls are folded into potion.c:potion_apply_food's table

notes: surv_food-s1 and surv_eat-s1 gate the eating flow and the hunger/exhaustion side; pot-apple-s1 and pot-poison-s1 gate the food potion effects. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): every reachable food's potion effect is in potion.c:potion_apply_food's table (the poisonous potato was missing until lane/itemuse, food-potato-s1); the per-fish rows need fishing (off). Formerly listed as missing: ItemFood's potion fields are hardcoded per item id in survival.c instead of carried per instance, so any food id outside the table eats without its effect. ItemFishFood's per-subtype heal and saturation (func_150905_g/func_150906_h overrides) are absent from the generated rows.
